prompt: Your goal of running 5k within a month turns out to be too much for your current fitness and schedule. What is the most helpful adjustment?

options.text: Shrink this month's target to running 2k comfortably, and build up from there
Give up running altogether, since the first goal failed
Keep the same deadline and force long runs every day, however exhausted you feel
Wait until you feel fitter before doing any running at all

explanation: Shrinking the target keeps the direction of the goal while making the next step achievable, so you keep building fitness and confidence instead of quitting or overdoing it.
